description: Close (fully or partially) one perp position with a reduce-only market order. The side is read from the live HL position: a long is closed with a sell, a short with a buy. Rejects when the position is flat/missing, when size exceeds it, or when a bare coin is open on several builder DEXes.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

coin.description: Asset symbol to close; builder-DEX assets as 'dex:ASSET', e.g. 'xyz:TSLA'

dex.description: Builder DEX for a bare coin, e.g. 'xyz' (omit for the default dex)

positionAddress.description: Address whose HL account holds the position — normally the MANAGED wallet from sign-in. Defaults to walletAddress.

price.description: Close price; omit or '0' to use the mark price

size.description: Size to close as a decimal string; omit to close the whole position

szDecimals.description: Market size decimals (HL meta szDecimals); rejects a size with more decimals

name: close_perp_position
